svg.title: SpecSpec architecture — control, data and persistence flows
svg.desc: Engineering introduction to the current format/API 4 implementation. A shared, unprivileged DOM/SVG canvas communicates through narrow VS Code or Electron adapters with a shared GraphSession and bounded, shell-free Python CLI bridge. Python owns the Markdown schema, snapshot construction, rooted DAG rules, edit planning, journaled managed writes, Git snapshots and semantic/source impact. Saved nodes live directly in _specspec; managed transaction state lives separately in .specspec-local. Blue arrows are control calls; teal arrows are records, bytes or text; orange arrows persist state or files; dashed purple arrows are refresh hints. A refresh flow shows coalesced watcher/document/Git events, overlay reads, last-valid-graph reconciliation, and token/full-membership render acknowledgements. Two save flows distinguish managed CLI/Electron/project-panel transactions from non-writing Python plans applied to VS Code TextDocuments and persisted by native Save. Native saves are not Python-journaled and can save invalid text. A final source map explains where to change domain rules, shared presentation, coordination and host adapters, and why serious Git/host tests clone the independently maintained Gantt bundle. No obsolete schema readers, approval gates, daemon or agent connectors are implied. Architectural arrows omit incidental calls; see architecture.md and the canonical specification graph for details.
svg.metadata: Documentation of the current checkout, not a proposed architecture. Source references are repository-relative. Hand-authored, self-contained SVG: no scripts, external fonts, images or remote assets. Companion: docs/architecture.md. Canonical reasoning: docs/own-spec.md and _specspec/.

g.text: ENGINEERING FIELD GUIDE / CURRENT FORMAT & API 4
One canonical Markdown DAG. One Python authority. One shared canvas. Two save lifecycles.
Follow calls and results across boundaries; the lower rows expand the lifecycles.
No filesystem, Git or process access
Camera / hover never mutate the DAG
Keep last valid graph; await render token
argv + UTF-8 stdin · shell:false · API 4 stdout
One root; types; links; cycles; withdrawal
Also called directly by engineers, agents & hooks.
Watchers / text or Git events / Refresh
Retry partial saves; polling defaults off
VS Code: disk + open text overlays
Invalid: keep last valid view + diagnostics
Invalid reloads disable managed writes, not native-buffer repair. Watchers are hints; no automatic file repair or delivery guarantee.

g.aria-label: Managed transactions versus native VS Code text-document persistence
g.text: C. Two edit lifecycles — same graph rules, different owners of Save
CLI / Electron / VS Code project panels
UI ports guard trust + draft conflicts
Clean state; return snapshot on success
Interrupted batch → retained journal → recover refuses unknown external bytes. Recovery is not atomic multi-file or full power-loss durability.
Minimal diff; shared buffers; undo / redo
Native Save can persist invalid text. Unapplied forms have per-view backups; managed project mutations refuse dirty native documents.
Schema, root/type grammar, DAG and withdrawal
Writer/recovery, native plans, diffs / exact index
Tests: tests/ · staged hook check validates blobs, not worktree.
New choices are conclusions, never per-node approval gates.
One source → generated VS Code / Electron assets
Do not hand-edit generated media or runtime copies.
Focus, colors, cameras and drafts are presentation, not node data.
Trust, lifecycle, transport, state & host security
Clone outside this repo for temporal / host tests.
Rewrite every maintained example ref after a node-schema change.
No daemon, approval workflow or implemented agent connector.
Format/API 4 only · five random bytes → padded Base64url IDs (keep “=”) · one manifesto → multi-parent requirements → terminal implementations.
Live nodes cannot depend on withdrawn parents. Retirement ≠ deletion / approval. Hosts render project Markdown as data, not executable HTML.

svg.text: Companion: docs/architecture.md · Canonical reasoning: docs/own-spec.md + _specspec/ · Architectural flows, not an exhaustive call graph.
